description: Watch something on a schedule and alert the workspace owner by email (and optionally a webhook) when it goes down or recovers. kind "http" checks a public URL (expectStatus, expectText), "ssl" warns before a certificate expires (sslDays), "heartbeat" returns a pingUrl your job calls when it finishes. kind "dns" watches public DNS records against its first successful baseline (dnsRecordType). Needs an approved workspace key; Free allows 20 monitors every 5 minutes or slower.

alertWebhook.description: Public URL that receives alert JSON.

target.description: URL or hostname for http and ssl.

name: create_monitor
